title: HATEPRISM: Policies, Platforms, and Research Integration. Advancing NLP for Hate Speech Proactive Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the linguistic inclusivity of 38 NLP hate speech datasets across 20 languages, assessing the representation of high-resource versus low-resource languages, and examining whether platform regulations automatically adjust to a user's local language.
Analyzing whether social media platforms and governmental guidelines adapt their definitions of hate speech and content moderation strategies to respect specific local, social, and cultural contexts.

Surveying dataset creation methodologies to assess whether annotator demographics (such as age, gender, race, religion, and education) are reported and whether the annotators are representative of the targeted minority groups.

Investigating the distribution of social media platforms used as data sources in NLP research, measuring the severe over-representation of specific platforms (e.g., X/Twitter) compared to others with much larger user bases (e.g., Facebook, WhatsApp).
